players.product: MLCCs (high-capacitance, mid/high-voltage, high-temperature and automotive-grade series used in server multiphase power modules), alloy current-sense resistors and inductors

quarterly_data.quarter: Fenghua Advanced Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (05-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Yin Jian (2025 annual results briefing): in Q1 2026 three MLCC products completed customer code qualification and entered batch delivery, seven new high-capacitance products are in development, and breakthroughs were made in three core materials - high-reliability ceramic powder for automotive MLCC, screen-printing paste and copper paste for automotive terminal electrodes; industrial-control and automotive orders grew steadily and sales of high-value special products, high-capacitance products, alloy resistors and thin-film resistors rose. He said the company does not yet supply NVIDIA directly and makes no copper-clad laminate products. New projects under way include a high-end resistor upgrade expansion and an expansion adding 1 hundred million high-current multilayer inductors a month; capacity utilization stays high, mature-product yields are stable at a high level and new-product yields keep improving.
quarterly_data.figure: 1 hundred million high-current multilayer inductors a month (expansion)
